item.title: 0.1.7 Beta 8
item.description:
# SakuraCord v0.1.7-Beta-8
## SakuraCord v0.1.7 Beta 8 (macOS 26 port)
Unofficial build of SakuraCord's nightly for macOS 26.5 / Xcode 26.6.
### From upstream (Beta 7 + Beta 8) - All upstream changes from SakuraCord nightly Beta 7 and Beta 8, including server join applications and smoother edited-message animations in the timeline.
### Port-specific - Fixes so Beta 7/8 compile with Swift 6.3. - Discord Rich Presence: games and apps that use Discord RPC show on your status and your own profile card (toggle in Settings → Features). - In-app updates: this nightly build checks the nightly feed. Use Check for Updates… to get the next nightly.
### Notes - Ad-hoc signed. On first launch, right-click → Open (or allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security).
